LanguageData.FHP_EnabledTip: When off, facial hair is drawn exactly where the game normally puts it. Your slider values are kept.
LanguageData.FHP_SideNote: West is mirrored from east automatically.
LanguageData.FHP_BackNote: Most beards are hidden behind the head from this angle.
LanguageData.FHP_Help: Positive X moves facial hair right (or forward, toward the face, in side views). Positive Y moves it up. 1.0 is one map tile. Use - and + to nudge; hold Shift for finer steps.
LanguageData.FHP_PreviewNoGame: Load a save to see a live preview on your pawns.
LanguageData.FHP_PreviewNoPawns: No pawns with facial hair on any map.
